operating_notes.text: Express parcel business delivered 1 billion e-commerce parcels in FY26.
Express parcel delivered over 1 billion shipments in FY26.
Incorporated wholly owned subsidiary Delhivery Fintech Distribution Private Limited for ₹1.00 Cr to offer financial and allied services.
Express parcel shipments were 322 Mn in Q1FY27, up 55.2% YoY, with express parcel revenue of ₹1,869 Cr.
PTL freight tonnage was 542K MT in Q1FY27, up 18.4% YoY but down 1.4% QoQ, with PTL revenue of ₹633 Cr.
Active customers rose to 54,096 at Jun-2026 from 43,022 a year earlier; infrastructure stood at 23.3 million sqft.

timeline.summary: On May 8, 2026, Delhivery reported that shareholders approved the appointment and remuneration of six independent directors via postal ballot.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,850 Cr, net profit ₹72.4 Cr.
Delhivery reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹2,848 Cr, up 30% YoY, and EBITDA of ₹231 Cr, while turning free cash flow positive for the full year FY26.
Delhivery approved the incorporation of wholly owned subsidiary Delhivery Fintech Distribution Private Limited with a subscription cost of ₹1.00 Cr.
Delhivery pays ₹11,800 fine to NSE for delayed SEBI Regulation 23(9) disclosure
Madhulika Vipin Madhulika Rawat and Vipin Rawat shared the earnings conference call recording link for Q4FY26 results on May 16, 2026.
Delhivery incorporated wholly owned subsidiary Delhivery Fintech Distribution Private Limited on June 2, 2026.
Q1FY27 (Aug 2026): Delhivery's revenue from services rose 27.8% YoY to ₹2,931 Cr on 322 Mn express parcels, but EBITDA fell to ₹156 Cr (5.3% margin) and PAT to ₹62 Cr from ₹91 Cr.

Delhivery Limited will host an earnings conference call on October 30, 2026, at 06:00 P.M. (IST) to discuss its unaudited standalone & consolidated financial results for Q2FY27 and H1FY27, with senior management present.
